claims.claim: AAOI posted a fifth consecutive quarter of record revenue in Q2 2026 at $191.9M, up from $103.0M a year earlier.
800G product volume more than doubled sequentially and management said 800G/1.6T demand should outpace production capacity through mid-2027, indicating a live AI-optics bottleneck signal.

risks.risk: Rapid capacity expansion can create utilization, yield and customer-concentration risk if demand timing changes.

unknowns.unknown: Customer-level concentration and committed versus forecast demand through mid-2027 are not quantified in this source.

claims.claim: AAOI returned to non-GAAP profitability in Q2 with $5.5M non-GAAP net income while revenue grew sequentially from $151.1M to $191.9M.

Manufacturing capacity was approaching 200,000 units per month and management targeted roughly 650,000 800G/1.6T units per month by year-end, making capacity-ramp delivery a concrete execution checkpoint.

risks.risk: GAAP net loss widened to $22.8M and GAAP gross margin fell to 27.7%, so revenue scale has not yet translated into GAAP profitability.

contradictions.contradiction: Record revenue and non-GAAP profitability coexist with a larger GAAP net loss and lower GAAP gross margin.

unknowns.unknown: Actual September production rate and progress toward the year-end 650,000-unit target are not established here.
